Healthopedia.

PRIVACY POLICY

Private by design.

Effective: 17 September 2026

Healthopedia is an educational herbal-reference app published by NDN Analytics Inc. It does not diagnose illness, prescribe treatment, dispense medicines, or replace professional medical care.

Information we collect

Healthopedia does not require an account and does not ask for your name, email address, phone number, precise location, health record, payment information, contacts, photos, camera, or microphone. Searches are processed on your device. Saved remedy references are stored locally on your device and are not synchronized to our servers.

Firebase and hosting

The app initializes a Firebase project container for hosting and future app services. Healthopedia currently does not enable Firebase Authentication, Analytics, Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Storage uploads, Crashlytics, advertising, or behavioral tracking. Firebase Hosting and Google Play may process ordinary technical request information, such as IP address, browser or device type, and request time, to securely deliver the app and operate their services.

External sources

Links to source documents and third-party health references open external websites. Those services have their own privacy practices, which Healthopedia does not control.

Children

Healthopedia is a general educational reference and is not directed to children. The app does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Retention and control

Saved entries remain on your device until you remove them, clear the collection, clear app storage, or uninstall the app. Because Healthopedia does not receive these saved entries, NDN Analytics Inc. cannot retrieve them.

Changes and contact

If this policy changes, the effective date above will be updated. Privacy questions can be submitted through the contact details published on NDN Analytics.
